subject: Exec slot stacking: technical deep-dive & sponsor alignment
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@heliohealth.com>, Tom Raines <tr@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec slot stacking: technical deep-dive & sponsor alignment

Hi Elaine / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our discussion, we’d like to run the technical deep-dive for HelioHealth and make sure we lock in a short executive slot so Tom (and any exec stakeholders) can join to review business outcomes and success criteria.

Current proposal (open to adjustment):
- Technical deep-dive: Tue, Nov 10, 11:00–12:00 PT (1hr) — engineering walkthrough, live Q&A
- Exec sponsor slot: 15 minutes at the end for Tom to surface priorities and ask top-level questions (11:45–12:00 PT)

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_HelioHealth_v2.xlsx (live MAP), agenda-exec-block.pdf (proposed blocking for exec + technical outline).

If Tom needs a separate slot (earlier or on a different day), we can "stack" an exec-only 30-minute block immediately prior to the public deep-dive or run a 30-minute exec preview on a separate day. What works best for your schedules?

Next steps: if you confirm availability, I’ll send updated invites and loop in CS for the technical session.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: MutualActionPlan_HelioHealth_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
Attachment: agenda-exec-block.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

From: Elaine Park <elaine@heliohealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Raines <tr@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec slot stacking: technical deep-dive & sponsor alignment

Avery —

Thanks for outlining this. Quick update from our side: Tom’s travel just shifted — he’s now on site in Boston Nov 10–11 and will only be available the morning of Nov 9 (09:00–10:00 PT) before a cross-country flight.

We want Tom to see the top-line outcomes and confirm the success criteria, but he won’t have bandwidth for the full technical hour. Two options that would work on our end:

1) Stack an exec-only 30-minute block on Mon, Nov 9 at 09:00 PT for Tom + our CPO to cover outcomes/metrics, then keep the technical deep-dive on Nov 10 as planned for engineers.
2) Move the entire one-hour technical deep-dive to Nov 9 morning so Tom can stay for the end of it (less preferred because of travel constraints).

Option 1 is our preference — can you confirm whether Redwood can run a 30-minute exec-only briefing on Nov 9 at 09:00 PT? If yes, please send a separate invite for the exec block and we’ll confirm Tom’s calendar.

Thanks —
Elaine Park
Sr. Program Manager | HelioHealth
elaine@heliohealth.com

Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec slot stacking: technical deep-dive & sponsor alignment

Elaine —

Thanks for the heads up. Stacking an exec-only slot on Mon, Nov 9 at 09:00 PT works for us. Proposed plan from Redwood’s side:

- Mon, Nov 9, 09:00–09:30 PT — Exec Briefing (Tom Raines, HelioHealth CPO, Redwood AE + CRO) — 30 min focused on business goals, KPIs, adoption plan, and decision criteria. We’ll keep this tightly scripted.
- Tue, Nov 10, 11:00–12:00 PT — Technical Deep-Dive (engineers, solutions + CS) — full walkthrough and hands-on Q&A.

I attached a short exec briefing PDF that highlights the 10-minute slot for outcomes, 10-minute for risks/rollout, and 10-minute for next steps and decisions. We’ll assign a single Redwood owner to take notes and capture commitments in the Mutual Action Plan.

Please confirm attendee list for the exec briefing and whether you want to include any internal product owners from HelioHealth. Once confirmed I’ll:
- Send a 30-min calendar invite for Nov 9, 09:00–09:30 PT (separate from the technical invite)
- Update the MAP with the decision checkpoints
- Add a short Zoom link + dial-in to both invites

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HL-2026-54 (I’ll log the exec briefing as a meeting on the record).

—Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: exec-briefing.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
